title: Read a call like a phrase
objective: Write a call as a short phrase, with of, at or a math name such as bigger, so it reads like a sentence.

body.text: A flowing call is a call written as a phrase. It has no brackets. The function name comes first, then a preposition or a value. of is used for a single value, as in first of names. at picks one item out of a list, as in things at 0. Some built-in functions, such as square root and bigger, also read this way.

body.title: of and at
body.code:
make names equal to a list of "Ana", "Bo", "Cy"
say first of names
say names at 1

body.text: Math functions come from a module. Write use math at the top of the program, and then the call reads as a phrase. bigger of a and b gives the larger of two numbers, and smaller of a and b gives the smaller one.

body.title: Math phrases
body.code:
use math

say square root of 16
say bigger of 3 and 9
say smaller of 3 and 9

body.text: A flowing call can sit inside a larger one. The inner phrase is read first, so the value it gives back is passed on.

body.title: A phrase inside a phrase
body.code:
use math

say square root of bigger of 9 and 16

body.prompt: The program prints the smaller of 3 and 9. Change it so it prints the larger of the two numbers, which is 9.
body.starter:
use math

say smaller of 3 and 9
body.solution:
use math

say bigger of 3 and 9
